```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, fig.show = "show")
```

```{r config-and-libraries, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(dplyr)

# Load config and functions
source(here("config.R"))
source(here("3_Analysis", "functions", "histogram_cont_var_func.r"))

# Output directory
hist_dir <- file.path(OUTPUT, "6_Histograms")
dir.create(hist_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data}
df <- read.csv(file.path(CLEAN_DATA, "final_dataset.csv"))
panel <- read.csv(file.path(PROCESSED_DATA, "panel_processed_5.csv"))
```

```{r restrict-sample}
# Keep only labgroupids with both BL and EL data, then keep the BL row
df_sample <- df %>%
  group_by(labgroupid) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%
  ungroup()

df_bl <- df_sample %>% filter(survey == "BL")
matched_labgroupids <- unique(df_bl$labgroupid)

# Restrict the equipment panel to the same matched sample and to BL
panel_bl <- panel %>% filter(survey == "BL", labgroupid %in% matched_labgroupids)
```

# Equipment Counts

```{r equipment-counts-prep}
# Each row in panel_bl is one equipment type/model for a lab; "number" gives
# the count of units of that row's type. Sum to get total units per lab per
# equipment type, then join onto every matched-sample lab (filling 0 for labs
# with none of that type, rather than dropping them).
equipment_labels <- c(
  fc        = "Fume Cupboards",
  fridge    = "Fridges",
  freezer   = "Freezers",
  ult       = "ULT Freezers",
  bath      = "Water Baths",
  heater    = "Block Heaters",
  microbio  = "Microbiological Safety Cabinets",
  incubator = "CO2 Incubators",
  glassware = "Glassware Drying Cabinets",
  cryostat  = "Cryostats",
  it        = "IT Equipment"
)

equip_counts <- panel_bl %>%
  group_by(labgroupid, equipment) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(number, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

df_equip <- df_bl %>% select(labgroupid, treated)
for (eq in names(equipment_labels)) {
  colname <- paste0("count_", eq)
  eq_sub <- equip_counts %>% filter(equipment == eq) %>% select(labgroupid, !!colname := count)
  df_equip <- df_equip %>% left_join(eq_sub, by = "labgroupid")
  df_equip[[colname]][is.na(df_equip[[colname]])] <- 0
}
```

```{r equipment-counts-plots, results = "asis"}
# Looped since all 11 equipment types share identical plotting logic;
# results = "asis" lets each iteration emit its own markdown subheader
for (eq in names(equipment_labels)) {
  colname <- paste0("count_", eq)
  label <- equipment_labels[[eq]]

  cat(paste0("\n\n## ", label, "\n\n"))

  p_overall <- make_histogram(
    df          = df_equip,
    variable    = colname,
    output_file = paste0("hist_", colname, "_overall.pdf"),
    binwidth    = 1,
    boundary    = 0,
    show_median = TRUE,
    output_dir  = hist_dir
  )
  print(p_overall)

  p_treatment <- make_histogram(
    df           = df_equip,
    variable     = colname,
    group_var    = "treated",
    group_labels = list("0" = "Control", "1" = "Treatment"),
    output_file  = paste0("hist_", colname, "_by_treatment.pdf"),
    binwidth     = 1,
    boundary     = 0,
    show_median  = TRUE,
    output_dir   = hist_dir
  )
  print(p_treatment)
}
```

# ULT Freezer Temperature

```{r ult-temp-prep}
# Per-unit (not per-lab) continuous variable: one row per ULT freezer
ult_temp <- panel_bl %>%
  filter(equipment == "ult") %>%
  mutate(temp_ult = as.numeric(temp_ult)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(temp_ult)) %>%
  left_join(df_bl %>% select(labgroupid, treated), by = "labgroupid")
```

```{r ult-temp-overall}
make_histogram(
  df          = ult_temp,
  variable    = "temp_ult",
  output_file = "hist_temp_ult_overall.pdf",
  binwidth    = 1,
  boundary    = 0,
  show_median = TRUE,
  output_dir  = hist_dir
)
```

```{r ult-temp-by-treatment}
make_histogram(
  df           = ult_temp,
  variable     = "temp_ult",
  group_var    = "treated",
  group_labels = list("0" = "Control", "1" = "Treatment"),
  output_file  = "hist_temp_ult_by_treatment.pdf",
  binwidth     = 1,
  boundary     = 0,
  show_median  = TRUE,
  output_dir   = hist_dir
)
```
